import pandas as pd

data = {
    "game": ["Orbit", "Tiles", "Quest", "Grove", "Castle", "Cards"],
    "genre": ["Strategy", "Puzzle", "Adventure", "Strategy", "Adventure", "Puzzle"],
    "minutes": [20, 15, 60, 35, 45, 10],
    "rating": [4.1, 3.8, 4.7, 4.4, 4.5, 3.6],
    "players": ["Two", "Solo", "Two", "Solo", "Two", "Solo"],
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.scatter(df["minutes"], df["rating"])
ax.set(title="Board games", xlabel="minutes", ylabel="rating")
